_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the SourceCoop egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: SourceCoop
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Black Mesa's single-player campaign played together, with the SourceCoop mod. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD, Metamod:Source, SourceMod and SourceCoop.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; exec ./srcds_run -game bms -console -norestart -strictportbind -ip 0.0.0.0 -port {{SERVER_PORT}} +maxplayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +mp_teamplay 1 +map {{STARTING_MAP}} ${STEAM_GSLT:++sv_setsteamaccount $STEAM_GSLT}

config.startup: {"done": "regex:Connection to Steam servers successful|gameserver Steam ID"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SourceCoop. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 346680) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously, then Metamod:Source, SourceMod and SourceCoop.
# Configs, saves and extra plugins are never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-346680}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# Metamod:Source, SourceMod and SourceCoop, each replaced only when its
# version changes. Their programs are replaced; the owner's configs, data
# and extra plugins are left alone (new config files are added).
ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
mkdir -p bms/addons

# alliedmods <name> <folder> <build>: prints the download for that build
# ("latest": the stable branch's newest), or fails.
alliedmods() {
    local name=$1 host=$2 want=$3 br file
    if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
        file=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "https://$host/1.12/$name-latest-linux") || return 2
        echo "https://$host/1.12/$file"
        return 0
    fi
    for br in 1.12 1.11; do
        file="$name-$br.0-git$want-linux.tar.gz"
        if curl -fsIL --retry 2 -A "$ua" -o /dev/null "https://$host/$br/$file"; then
            echo "https://$host/$br/$file"
            return 0
        fi
    done
    return 1
}
# addon <label> <url> <marker>: unpacks a Metamod or SourceMod release into bms/.
addon() {
    local label=$1 url=$2 marker=$3 file=${2##*/}
    if [ "$(cat "$marker" 2>/dev/null)" = "$file" ]; then
        echo "$label ${file%-linux.tar.gz} is already installed."
        return
    fi
    echo "Downloading $label ${file%-linux.tar.gz}"
    rm -rf "$work/x" && mkdir -p "$work/x"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$work/a.tar.gz" "$url" || fail "The $label download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xzf "$work/a.tar.gz" -C "$work/x" || fail "The $label download is damaged. Reinstall to try again."
    # Configs: only the missing ones. Everything else: replaced.
    find "$work/x" -type f | while read -r f; do
        rel=${f#"$work/x/"}
        case "$rel" in
        addons/sourcemod/configs/* | cfg/* | addons/metamod/*.vdf | addons/metamod/*.ini | addons/metamod.vdf)
            [ -e "bms/$rel" ] && continue ;;
        esac
        mkdir -p "bms/$(dirname "$rel")"
        cp -f "$f" "bms/$rel"
    done
    echo "$file" > "$marker"
}

want="${MMS_BUILD:-latest}"
url=$(alliedmods mmsource mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop "$want") || {
    [ $? = 2 ] && fail "AlliedModders can't be reached right now to download Metamod:Source. Reinstall to try again."
    fail "Metamod:Source has no Linux build $want. Set Metamod:Source build to latest, or to a build number from its downloads page."
}
addon Metamod:Source "$url" bms/addons/.raptor-metamod
want="${SM_BUILD:-latest}"
url=$(alliedmods sourcemod sm.alliedmods.net/smdrop "$want") || {
    [ $? = 2 ] && fail "AlliedModders can't be reached right now to download SourceMod. Reinstall to try again."
    fail "SourceMod has no Linux build $want. Set SourceMod build to latest, or to a build number from its downloads page."
}
addon SourceMod "$url" bms/addons/.raptor-sourcemod

repo=ampreeT/SourceCoop
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
if ! tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want" 2>/dev/null); then
    [ "$want" = latest ] && fail "GitHub can't be reached right now to download SourceCoop. Reinstall to try again."
    fail "SourceCoop has no version $want. Set SourceCoop version to latest, or to one of its releases, such as $(gh-release tag "$repo" latest 2>/dev/null || echo v1.6)."
fi
zip=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk '$1 ~ /-bms\.zip$/ { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$zip" ] || fail "SourceCoop $tag has no Black Mesa download. Choose another version."
if [ "$(cat bms/addons/.raptor-sourcecoop 2>/dev/null)" = "$zip" ]; then
    echo "SourceCoop $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading SourceCoop $tag"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$zip" "$work/sc.zip" || fail "The SourceCoop download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    unzip -qo "$work/sc.zip" -x 'addons/sourcemod/configs/*' 'addons/sourcemod/data/srccoop/savedata/*' -d bms || fail "The SourceCoop download is damaged. Reinstall to try again."
    unzip -qn "$work/sc.zip" 'addons/sourcemod/configs/*' 'addons/sourcemod/data/srccoop/savedata/*' -d bms 2>/dev/null || true
    echo "$zip" > bms/addons/.raptor-sourcecoop
fi
[ -f bms/addons/sourcemod/plugins/srccoop.smx ] || fail "SourceCoop didn't install (srccoop.smx is missing). Reinstall to try again."

# server.cfg: SourceCoop's recommended settings the first time; after that
# only the lines the Panel fills in are added when missing.
cfg=bms/cfg/server.cfg
mkdir -p bms/cfg
if [ ! -f "$cfg" ]; then
    cat > "$cfg" <<'EOF'
// Black Mesa co-op with SourceCoop. The Panel sets hostname, sv_password,
// rcon_password, mp_friendlyfire and mod_forcetouchdata at every start.
hostname ""
sv_password ""
rcon_password ""
mp_friendlyfire 0
mod_forcetouchdata 1
mp_teamplay 1
mp_fraglimit 0
mp_timelimit 0
mp_forcerespawn 1
sv_always_run 0
mp_mapcycle_empty_timeout_seconds 3600
sv_tags "custom, coop, sourcecoop"
sv_cheats 0
sv_alltalk 1
EOF
fi
for key in hostname sv_password rcon_password mp_friendlyfire mod_forcetouchdata; do
    grep -q "^$key " "$cfg" || echo "$key \"\"" >> "$cfg"
done
echo "Installed Black Mesa build ${build:-unknown} with SourceCoop $tag, $(sed 's/-linux.tar.gz//' bms/addons/.raptor-sourcemod) and $(sed 's/-linux.tar.gz//' bms/addons/.raptor-metamod)."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Starting map
variables.description: The campaign map the server starts on: bm_c0a0a is the beginning, and each chapter has its own, such as bm_c1a0a.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The password for remote admin tools, or empty to turn RCON off.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Preload map data
variables.description: Load each map's models up front, which runs smoother; turn it off if a map (such as bm_c4a4a) crashes or hangs.

variables.name: Game server token
variables.description: A Steam game server login token for app 362890, so the server keeps its identity; empty runs without one.

variables.name: SourceCoop version
variables.description: The SourceCoop release to install, such as v1.6, or latest. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: SourceMod build
variables.description: The SourceMod build to install, such as 7260, or latest for the newest stable one. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Metamod:Source build
variables.description: The Metamod:Source build to install, such as 1230, or latest for the newest stable one. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update Black Mesa from Steam every time the server starts. Off by default: a game update can break SourceCoop until it catches up.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
